lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Light sprinkling with rosecan on raised nursery beds.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Nursery soil enriched with vermicompost (2:1:1 soil:sand:compost). Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for damping-off (Pythium/Rhizoctonia) in young seedlings.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Cover nursery beds with 40-mesh insect-proof net to prevent whitefly transmission of Tomato Leaf Curl Virus.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Pre-irrigate field to prepare ridges and furrows.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Apply FYM @ 20 tonnes/ha + Basal full P, full K, and 1/3rd N.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for root-knot nematode galling history.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Make raised beds or ridges to facilitate good drainage and furrow irrigation.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Immediate light irrigation after transplanting in afternoon hours.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Dip seedling roots in Pseudomonas fluorescens suspension (0.2%) for 15 mins.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for transplant shock and cutworm damage.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Transplant 25-30 day old sturdy seedlings at 60x45 cm or 75x60 cm spacing.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 4. पौधे का जमाव एवं प्रारंभिक वृद्धि
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at 5-7 day intervals depending on soil moisture.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No heavy fertilizer until root anchoring is complete.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for leaf miner (serpentine mines) and early thrips.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Keep field weed-free with shallow hoeing.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Maintain uniform soil moisture; avoid alternate drought and over-flooding.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (curled thickened leaves) and Early Blight (target spot lesions).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Stake indeterminate varieties with bamboo poles or trellis wire to keep foliage off the ground.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Regular furrow or drip irrigation; moisture stress causes flower drop.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of Boron (20% Solubor) @ 1g/L and 19:19:19 @ 3g/L to prevent blossom drop.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Install pheromone traps (Helilure) @ 5/acre to monitor Helicoverpa fruit borer moths.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid heavy chemical spraying during honeybee active hours.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Uniform irrigation; irregular watering leads to Blossom End Rot and fruit cracking.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 2nd Top-dressing of Potassium (MOP/SOP) + Calcium Nitrate @ 10 kg/acre.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for fruit borer entrance holes and Late Blight greasy rot on green fruits.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Maintain continuous optimum moisture to prevent fruit skin splitting.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Moderate irrigation; do not waterlog root zone.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No nitrogen fertilizer at this stage.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Harvest at 'breaker stage' (pink tinge at blossom end) for distant transport.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Light irrigation after each major picking.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Optional foliar micronutrient spray to sustain subsequent pickings.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Separate and destroy bored fruits away from field.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Pick fruits along with pedicel in early morning or late afternoon.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Sort out damaged, bruised, or virus-infected fruits.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Pack in plastic crates instead of rough gunny bags to reduce transit damage.
